headline: Germany Approves 2027 Budget with 210.4 Billion Euro Borrowing Plan
summary: The German Bundestag has approved the 2027 federal budget, which includes plans for 210.4 billion euros in new debt.
why: Germany is the largest economy in the Eurozone; its fiscal policy and debt issuance significantly impact European bond markets and interest rate expectations.

impacts.name: German Bund yield
impacts.why: Increased government borrowing typically puts upward pressure on bond yields.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Large-scale debt issuance increases the supply of government bonds, which can drive up yields.
